explanation: Lúcio Costa drew the city's plan, often compared to an aeroplane or a bird, while Niemeyer designed its landmark buildings. Brasília was inaugurated in 1960.

claims.text: Oscar Niemeyer designed the Cathedral of Brasília and many of Brasília's principal buildings.
Lúcio Costa, Le Corbusier and Luis Barragán did not design the Cathedral of Brasília.
Lúcio Costa designed the master plan of Brasília, often likened to an aeroplane or a bird.
